hero.headline: Уютен коворкинг в Пловдив за фрийлансъри и дистанционно работещи

paragraphs: Идвате с лаптопа, привлечени от добрите ни цени, но оставате, защото нещо в пространството просто ви пасва.
Топло е. Спокойно е. Усеща се като хора, не само като бюра.
Бърз Wi-Fi, уютни ъгълчета и общностно ориентирано коворкинг пространство в сърцето на Пловдив.

items.quote: The place is super cozy, calm and makes you want to work with pleasure. The two girls who created and maintain it are great people - always smiling, responsive and create a feeling that you are among friends, not just in a co-working space. There is everything you need - comfortable places to work, corners for privacy, a place to eat, and the garden is an absolute bonus. From time to time they also organize super nice gatherings - barbecues, entertainment, and recently they also organized a movie night just for girls with a movie, snacks and a very good mood. It is obvious that this place was made with desire and attitude. I recommend it with both hands!
items.name: Silvia Naydenova

items.quote: Cozy place with great hosts! Good not only for working there, but events too!
items.name: Veneta Fm

items.quote: Really nice co-working space. I actually made friends here, which made the whole experience special. Good atmosphere, comfortable place to work, and just a great vibe overall.
items.name: Yuliyan Petkov

items.quote: An excellent place to work with a friendly atmosphere and comfort.
items.name: Ivan Atanassov

items.quote: Best co-working space in Plovdiv if you want to have some fun and great conversations while you work. The day passes by quickly because you're having a good time! The owners are two lovely sisters who will make you feel welcome every time you want to visit even if you're not a regular
items.name: Aleksandra Kamenova

items.quote: Raboteriya offers the perfect balance between productivity and community. The workspace is modern, clean, and comfortable, with fast and reliable internet—everything you need to stay focused and get work done efficiently. What truly sets this place apart is the people and the atmosphere. The community is friendly, open, and inspiring, making it easy to connect and collaborate. The team behind Raboteriya goes above and beyond to create a welcoming and positive environment. The game nights and parties are a huge highlight—they bring everyone together, create real connections, and make the whole experience much more than just a place to work. It feels like a community, not just a coworking space. If you're looking for the best coworking experience in Plovdiv, this is it. Highly recommended!
items.name: Georgi Angelov

items.quote: A very cozy place where people can relax and be themselves. Made with taste and desire for every detail, and Alex's food is divine! There is no feeling of grayness and boredom, which is often present in the office. I recommend it with both hands!
items.name: Vesela Ganeva

items.quote: Been here since a month and it is genuinely an amazing place to work from in Plovdiv. The hosts are extremely friendly and caring, the environment is cozy, there is everything you need in a working environment: coffee, water, snacks and most importantly a cat. They also have extra monitors for people who require more than one screen. The people attending this place are interesting, fun and hard-working. The atmosphere is also very entrepreneurial. You can learn a lot by just chatting with people in between work sessions. If you are looking for a working environment that will also satisfy your socialization needs, this is the perfect place to be. I highly recommend it.
items.name: Teodor Mironov

items.quote: The place has such a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The owners are absolute sunshines - they genuinely care about their clients and always go the extra mile to make everyone feel comfortable. They're open to new ideas and are constantly thinking about how to make the coworking space even better. You can really feel the heart and passion behind every decision that has been made.
items.name: Gergana Andreeva

items.quote: I've been working at Coworking Space Raboteriya Plovdiv for nearly a year, and it has been an absolute pleasure! The environment is both professional and fun, making it the perfect place to focus and connect with like-minded people. The owners are truly wonderful—friendly, approachable, and always willing to help or enhance the space based on members' needs.
items.name: Anton Tonev

items.quote: Such a lovely space which is filled with even lovelier people. The atmosphere is soothing and perfect to work in, it is spacious and welcoming. The desks and work spaces are large and well spaced out, meaning you can stay here all day and get on with any work necessary. There is a kitchen area which is fully equipped with a microwave, kettle, coffee machine and fridge. I really couldn't recommend this space enough.
items.name: Liz Shamsee

items.quote: Top place to work, very nice atmosphere! They offer coffee and tea, people are always open for conversation, even for 10 minutes a day it is a great relief from the stressful everyday life. There are two separate rooms, which makes it convenient for holding business meetings. Super fresh!
items.name: Valya Matovska

items.quote: A great place where you can combine work with fun. Fresh and pleasant atmosphere with friendly, smiling and radiant people. I recommend!
items.name: Vasil Koychev

items.quote: Gorgeous place, I highly recommend it! Very cozy, calm, friendly atmosphere and everything you need to feel good while working!
items.name: Megi Ivanova

items.quote: Cws is seriously amazing, It's open 24/7! The environment there makes me be so productive with loads of comfy seating to choose from. It's always clean, plus they've got coffee and snacks, which is a major win. Location is so convenient too, around the corner there is a shop and many street food places. Totally recommend it!
items.name: Maya

items.quote: This is my favourite place to get some work done! The atmosphere and design is great. I love that there's amenities to help me get through my long work days at the space. The space is also located in an ideal area, close to many shops and establishments used by students and workers. It honestly feels like a second home, and the owner is so sweet & accommodating, which makes it a pleasure to always come back. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to work in a lovely, comfortable environment.
items.name: Sinat Azeez

items.quote: Such a warm and inviting place to get my work done! Not to mention, the management is amazing, always super responsive and makes the space feel like a home away from home ❤️
items.name: Berry Jude

items.quote: Absolutely obsessed with this place!! It has everything I need and so much more. Love the chill atmosphere and I'm always able to get so much work done whenever I visit. Plus the owner is amazing and super welcoming. Great place to work. Super comfortable and very well thought of, couldn't have asked for a better place to be!!
items.name: Gamze Zengin

items.quote: Really nice co-working place! Owners are chill and fix problems fast. It's cozy, convenient location, and price is fair. Also, new coffee beans are excellent :)
items.name: Ivaylo Petrov

items.quote: The best place for coworking in Plovdiv. I highly recommend it 🙌
items.name: Nadejda Ilieva

items.quote: Very nice atmosphere, I liked it. Each work area has its own style and feel. It's obvious that it was made with love and care. The prices are competitive. I use it on days when I'm tired of working from home in shorts!
items.name: Martin Gatev

items.quote: Very cosy place, extremely polite hosts, nice environment. Highly recommend for teams, events, and freelancers.
items.name: Tsanislav Georgiev

items.quote: Whether you're looking for a spacious place to work at, or a quiet one so you can be more focused they have it all. Extremely friendly atmosphere, amazing host, chill vibes and comfy couches. They are the best at what they provide!!
items.name: Kiro Iliev

community.heading: Намери своите хора, не само бюро
paragraphs: В Raboteriya често срещаш фрийлансъри, хора на дистанционна работа и собственици на малки бизнеси - всеки със свои истории, идеи, умения и контакти. Понякога най-полезният разговор за деня не е на среща. Започва непринудено, между две задачи, докато правиш кафе в кухнята.

Затова оставяме място за повече от работа. Всяка седмица се събираме за кино вечери, настолни игри, BBQ в градината или спокойни вечери на дивана, след като лаптопите се затворят. Без насилена мрежа. Без корпоративни ледоразбивачи. Просто място, където хората постепенно стават познати - и работните дни се усещат малко по-малко самотни.

faq.subheading: Знаем, че изборът на коворкинг води до въпроси. Ето отговорите на най-често задаваните.

items.question: Нужна ли е резервация?
items.answer: Да - моля, направете го. Тъй като сме уютно, общностно пространство, местата могат да са ограничени. Свържете се с нас поне един ден предварително, за да сме сигурни, че има място за вас.

items.question: Какво е положението с паркирането?
items.answer: Изненадващо лесно. Макар да сме близо до центъра, Raboteriya е в жилищен район. Околните улици са с безплатно паркиране и обикновено има свободни места.

items.question: Има ли места за хранене наблизо?
items.answer: Толкова много. На няколко минути пеша ще намерите:
list: Nolita - български ресторант с достъпни обедни менюта
items.answerFooter: Mall Plovdiv и Sombrero Mexican Restaurant също са на около 10 минути пеша, така че опциите за обяд никога не са проблем.

items.question: Как се влиза?
items.answer: След като станете член, ви даваме карта за достъп - просто докосвате картата и влизате. Ако е първото ви посещение, ще ви посрещнем и ще ви покажем всичко.

items.question: Мога ли да посетя преди да реша?
items.answer: Разбира се. Ще ви покажем пространството, за да усетите атмосферата и да решите дали Raboteriya е за вас.

items.question: Има ли договори при членствата?
items.answer: Не. Всички членства са на месечна основа без дългосрочни ангажименти. Не вярваме в заключване на хора - предпочитаме да останете, защото наистина обичате да работите тук.

items.question: Може ли да се наема за събития?
items.answer: Да! Raboteriya може да се наеме за събития. Правили сме тиймбилдинги, семинари, работилници, рождени дни и сватби до 40 души.

items.question: Почиства ли се редовно?
items.answer: Абсолютно. Поддържаме Raboteriya чиста, подредена и гостоприемна - за да влезете, да работите спокойно и да се чувствате добре.

items.question: Допускате ли домашни любимци?
items.answer: Да. Обичаме пухкавите приятели и сте добре дошли с домашен любимец. Рециклираме пластмаса и даряваме средствата на Animal Rescue Sofia - грижата за животните е важна за нас.

items.question: Имате ли статичен IP адрес?
items.answer: Да - WiFi е със статичен IP, за да е стабилна и предвидима настройката ви.

items.question: Мога ли да работя с допълнителен екран?
items.answer: Да. В Raboteriya има допълнителни екрани. Resident членовете са с приоритет, но досега Flex членовете и посетителите с day pass винаги са успявали да ползват.

items.question: Мога ли да регистрирам фирма на адреса на Raboteriya?
items.answer: Да - членовете могат да ползват адреса на Raboteriya като официален фирмен адрес. Практично, ако не искате регистрация у дома или ви трябва място за кореспонденция.

items.question: Удобна ли е Raboteriya, ако живея в Смирненски или близо до Пещерско?
items.answer: Да - Raboteriya е близо до центъра и удобна, ако идвате от кв. Христо Смирненски, Пещерско шосе или западната част на Пловдив. Идвате лесно, без да пресичате целия град.

items.question: Лесно ли се стига до Raboteriya с влак/автобус?
items.answer: Да - на 10 минути пеша сме от Централната гара Пловдив и основната автогара. Удобно е, ако идвате от друг град за деня.
